datasets.help: Per data row its columns and its error bars, each key of a row described under keys. instance.set replaces the whole list: a row without errorBars gets { mode: 'none' }. To change columns only, read the list, change it and write it back including errorBars.

x.label: X
x.title: The X column of the row (slot X), numeric and required
x.help: The X column of the row (slot X), numeric and required. Without it the row is kept but not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

y.label: Y
y.title: The Y column of the row (slot Y), numeric and required
y.help: The Y column of the row (slot Y), numeric and required. Without it the row is kept but not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

group.label: G
group.title: The group column of the row (slot G), optional
group.help: The group column of the row (slot G), optional; it colours the points by group value. Empty until one is chosen.

size.label: S
size.title: The bubble size column (slot S), numeric and optional
size.help: The bubble size column (slot S), numeric and optional; it turns the points into bubbles whose diameter shows the value. Empty until one is chosen.

errorBars.label: Error bars
errorBars.help: The error bars of the row: the mode and, depending on the mode, under constant, columns or columnsAbsolute an amount or a column per direction. Without them the row shows no error bars.

mode.help: How the errors are given: 'none' (no bars), 'constant' (one fixed amount per direction), 'columns' (one column per direction with the distance from the point) or 'columnsAbsolute' (one column per direction with the bar's end point, e.g. 95 and 110 around the value 100). Changing the mode clears all four values.

constant.help: The fixed amounts per direction, only in mode 'constant'. A missing direction or null means no bar in that direction; a negative amount counts as its absolute value.

xPlus.label: +X
xPlus.help: The error to the right (+x): an amount. Empty means no bar in this direction.

xMinus.label: −X
xMinus.help: The error to the left (−x): an amount. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yPlus.label: +Y
yPlus.help: The error upwards (+y): an amount. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yMinus.label: −Y
yMinus.help: The error downwards (−y): an amount. Empty means no bar in this direction.

columns.help: One numeric column per direction holding each point's distance to the end of its bar, only in mode 'columns'. A missing direction means no bar; so does an empty or non-numeric cell, the point stays.

xPlus.label: +X
xPlus.help: The error to the right (+x): a numeric column with the distance from the point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

xMinus.label: −X
xMinus.help: The error to the left (−x): a numeric column with the distance from the point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yPlus.label: +Y
yPlus.help: The error upwards (+y): a numeric column with the distance from the point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yMinus.label: −Y
yMinus.help: The error downwards (−y): a numeric column with the distance from the point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

columnsAbsolute.help: One numeric column per direction holding the end point of each point's bar as a coordinate on the axis, only in mode 'columnsAbsolute' — e.g. the lower and upper limit of a confidence interval. A missing direction means no bar; so does an empty or non-numeric cell, the point stays.

xMinus.label: −X
xMinus.help: The left end of the bar (−x): a numeric column with the x coordinate per point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

xPlus.label: +X
xPlus.help: The right end of the bar (+x): a numeric column with the x coordinate per point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yMinus.label: −Y
yMinus.help: The lower end of the bar (−y): a numeric column with the y coordinate per point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

yPlus.label: +Y
yPlus.help: The upper end of the bar (+y): a numeric column with the y coordinate per point. Empty means no bar in this direction.

stats.help: Per plotted series the statistics of its Y values and confidence intervals, structured like modules.shared.types.SeriesStats; null while nothing can be computed.

legacySeries.help: Display settings from older saved states, one entry per series by position (name, colour, symbol, size, border, visibility, connecting line). They apply before the settings of the chart editor and are cleared as soon as the data rows change. Not meant to be set by hand.

series.help: The series built from the data rows with their display (name, X and Y values, colour, symbol, connecting line, bubble sizes), or an object with "error" and "params" when no series can be formed.

visibleSeries.help: The visible series after the settings of the chart editor, in the order of the statistics table; empty while there are no series.

clearLegacySeries.help: Discards the display settings from older saved states. Runs by itself when the data rows change.

params.command: The command as an object without parameters.

setErrorBars.help: Set the error bars of one data row: none, constant amounts in +x, −x, +y and −y, or one column per direction holding the distance from the point ('columns') or the bar's end point ('columnsAbsolute'). The whole spec is replaced: changing the mode clears all four values, directions left out get no bar.

params.command: The command as one object { index, spec }.
params.index: The number of the data row, 0-based, as in read().datasets.
params.spec: The error bars in the same form as read().datasets[i].errorBars: { mode: 'none' }, { mode: 'constant', constant: { xPlus?, xMinus?, yPlus?, yMinus? } } with numbers, { mode: 'columns', columns: { … } } (distances from the point) or { mode: 'columnsAbsolute', columnsAbsolute: { … } } (bar end points) with column references { instanceId, sheetId, columnId }. A missing direction means no bar; only the variant of the chosen mode is allowed.
